title: Soap boat
scene: A toy sailboat floats in a basin beside an oval soap bar and big bubbles; ROB's friendly face peeks around the basin at eye level.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Produce ONE original finished portrait children's coloring-book illustration, not a montage. Puppy is a small floppy-eared dog with plain collar. Include only characters named in the scene, never add ROB when it says no robot. Draw specifically the described action and viewpoint with natural interaction, not stock standing front view. Coherent scene, 4-6 main elements, big shapes and broad outlines.
